title: Constancy Theorem 8.4.1 (corrected: M ∩ U connected)
statement: Let V be a stationary n-varifold in open U ⊆ ℝ^N, M an n-dimensional C² submanifold of ℝ^N in Simon's sense (IsSimonSubmanifold 2 M), U ∩ spt μ_V ⊆ M, and M ∩ U preconnected (corrected hypothesis; the printed 'M connected' is false). Then there is θ0 ≥ 0 with V(A) = θ0 · H^n({x ∈ M ∩ U : (x, T_xM) ∈ A}) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^N × G(N,n), where T_xM is the plane equal to the classical tangent space classicalTangentSpace M x (velocities of C¹ curves in M through x). (Exactly ConstancyTheorem.)
